revise.text: In AUTO-RENEWAL & BILLING, when the document says there is no automatic renewal, name only the other charges it expressly authorizes, such as fees, damage claims, or price changes, in the document's own words; if it names none, say the document names no other charges. Never add an amount, deadline, or charge the document does not state.

In DATA DELETION RIGHTS, give the retention period, the data that survives a deletion request, and any limit to certain residents only when the document states them, in its own words; where the document is silent on one of these, say it does not say. Never name a state, law, period, or exemption the document does not print.
